messages:
Samir: Heads-up - just got pinged by a customer that they didn't receive an alert for the spike this morning. Checking our incident channel and it looks like the paging integration didn't fire for the alert at 08:42 UTC.
Jules: confirmed, I see the alert in Sentry but no pager event in paging-service logs.
Maria: ops-bot shows a series of 502s from /notify/webhook upstream around 08:41-08:43. Could be auth rotation fallout?
Samir: @notifier-bot dump recent webhook responses?
notifier-bot: recent_responses (08:35-08:45): [200, 200, 502, 502, 204, 200] - note: 204 responses were treated as success by suppressor; last 502s correlate with missing fanout.
Lee (on-call): I didn't get a page. I was online. Can we escalate manually now?
Jules: Lee - manual page is happening. Priya, can you confirm phone number fallback worked?
Priya: calling Lee via SMS fallback now. Lee: got the SMS and voicemail, thanks.
Maria: quick hypothesis: the relay started returning 502 for a short window, but our suppressor/health-check considered the relay healthy because it treats 204 as a nominal success code; when upstream returned 502 then 204 intermittently our circuit logic suppressed pages.
Samir: that matches the logs. Example HTTP traces: ```
POST /notify/webhook HTTP/1.1
Host: relay-us.example
Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx
Response: 502 Bad Gateway
--- 30s later ---
Response: 204 No Content
```
Jules: oy. So two failures then an odd 204 caused the state machine to flip to 'ok' without replaying missed pages. We need a live mitigation: route to fallback relay and restart notifier-worker to clear any stuck suppression windows.
Priya: on it. Switching routing policy to fallback-relay-2 now (manual override): ```
$ curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/override -d '{"route":"fallback-relay-2","reason":"emergency paging fallback"}'
```
ops-bot: routing override applied by Priya at 08:47:12 UTC.
notifier-bot: notifier-worker-4 restart queued.
Maria: restarting notifier-worker-4 now. Watch logs for drained queues.
Samir: reminder to call the affected customer contact and apologize + confirm they saw the manual SMS/voicemail. Jules, can you draft a short note we can paste to customer?
Jules: drafting: "We saw a short interruption in our automated paging system that prevented pages during a brief relay error window. We manually escalated and reached out via SMS/voicemail at 08:47 UTC. Root cause under investigation; we'll follow up with timeline and remediation."
Lee (on-call): I can confirm new pages are coming through on fallback. I just received a test alert.
Maria: notifier-worker-4 restarted and drained 12 pending events - they were re-queued to fallback-relay-2 and delivered.
Samir: good. Can someone capture a quick timeline for the postmortem? Key points: detection, customer report, manual escalation, mitigations performed, root cause hypothesis, customer impact.
Priya: timeline snippet: 08:41:12 - alert triggered in Sentry; 08:41:45 - relay returned 502; 08:42:10 - relay returned 204; 08:43:00 - customer reports missing page; 08:43:20 - manual check and thread started; 08:47:12 - routing override applied; 08:48:00 - notifier restarted; 08:49:10 - pages delivered via fallback.
Jules: temp mitigation looks good. For next steps: revert override only after we confirm stability for 30m and postmortem to include safer health-check semantics (treat intermittent 204 after failures as suspicious).
Samir: also add a runbook step to actively replay pending events if a worker restarts and suppression was active. Might be a gap in current logic.
Maria: agreed. I'll open an infra ticket to change suppressor health scoring and add an e2e test for the relay auth rotation scenario.
Lee (on-call): FYI customer is asking if any alerts were missed for the last 24h — I checked and only this window (08:41-08:49) looks affected.
Samir: good catch. Please include that in the customer update.
Jules: note for postmortem: mitigation commands used and minimal logs, attach dump from notifier-bot for audit.
notifier-bot: audit_log_id=az-90823 delivered_events=12 replayed=true
Maria: creating postmortem draft and assigning action items: (1) change health-check policy, (2) add replay-on-restart, (3) add alerting on suppressor flip after recent failures, (4) validate fallback-relay churn handling.
Priya: I'll follow up on (4) and schedule a drill to validate fallback paths next week.
Samir: thanks all. I'll PH the customer update after postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
Jules: leaving this thread open until postmortem doc is published. :white_check_mark:
